newsitem.title: ITALY: Suspension of telecom stocks not warranted - Consob. [CORRECTED 18:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Suspension of telecom stocks not warranted - Consob. [CORRECTED 18:10 GMT]

text.p: High trading volumes in shares in Stet and Telecom Italia rule out the possibility of suspending trading in the stocks ahead of a merger between the two companies, Enzo Berlanda, President of bourse watchdog Consob said (Corrects to add dropped name and source.)

The government announced on Monday that it intends to merge the two companies, removing them from the books of state holding company IRI and placing them in the hands of the Treasury in advance of their privatisation.

"When a company has such a dispersed ownership there is not a problem of suspending the shares," said Berlanda, adding that 662 million Stet shares and 379 million Telecom shares had changed hands in three days.
IRI owns some 64 percent of Stet's ordinary stock. Stet in turn has a controlling interest in Telecom Italia.
